blocks.raw:
> \[!NOTE]
> To allocate Goodwill Request points in Member Care, you must turn on the Points Adjustment Settings toggle and configure a Default Till. If either setting is missing, the system approves the request but does not credit points to the customer. This happens because the points allocation step is skipped when the till cannot be resolved.
